The messiah is Jacob Frank's daughter Eva. The first thing to understand about their religion is that the messiah is a woman. Second, this religion has an eschatology where eternal life comes at the end of days. Unlike most religions where dying leads to becoming a spirit, they believe in enjoying life fully—sex, food, and alcohol. At the end of days, the big brother will come as an interdimensional higher god, granting them wealth and freedom from death.

A prince marries a goddess who kills their two children. The prince leaves but later confronts her about it. She explains that by killing the kids, they've gone to learn wisdom in other dimensions, becoming strong and beautiful. Jacob Frank teaches not to question him as he can access different dimensions for the greater good.

When I was little, I tasted fruit at an old lord's garden and decided to steal some branches to plant myself. The lord warned me about a trap but I measured the wall and made a ladder. Noticing a cord lying along the wall, I deduced there was a trap and cut it off, taking three branches with my lads. Guards were posted at night, so we fired guns to keep them awake for three nights before stealing more fruit when they fell asleep. The lord confronted me, but I returned only with someone who had been present during the initial conversation.
